cd /workspace/tmp/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/dev')
# single-window max: 8 scopes x 256 subnets = 2048 /64s
m = {"version":1,"seed":2**64-1,"low_count":32,"attempts":3,"spacing_ms":1000,"timeout_ms":1000000,
     "windows":[{"id":"w","start_ms":10**12,"scopes":[]}]}
for s in range(8):
    m['windows'][0]['scopes'].append({"id":"s%02d"%s,"prefix":"2001:db8:%04x::/56"%s,"subnets":list(range(256))})
open('t/one_max.json','w').write(json.dumps(m))
t0=time.time()
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/submission/ipv6_replay.py','plan','t/one_max.json'],capture_output=True)
wall=time.time()-t0
plan = json.loads(r.stdout)
print('exit', r.returncode, 'wall %.2fs'%wall, 'probes', len(plan['probes']), 'stdout MB %.1f'%(len(r.stdout)/1e6))
ids = [p['id'] for p in plan['probes']]
assert len(set(ids)) == 208896
last = plan['probes'][-1]
print('last probe:', last['id'], last['sent_ms'], last['deadline_ms'])
assert last['sent_ms'] == 10**12 + 208895*1000
# shuffled subnets must give the same plan
import random
rng = random.Random(3)
m2 = json.loads(json.dumps(m))
for sc in m2['windows'][0]['scopes']:
    rng.shuffle(sc['subnets'])
rng.shuffle(m2['windows'][0]['scopes'])
open('t/one_max2.json','w').write(json.dumps(m2))
r2 = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/submission/ipv6_replay.py','plan','t/one_max2.json'],capture_output=True)
print('shuffle-independent:', json.loads(r2.stdout) == plan)
EOF

cd /workspace/tmp/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
# CRLF manifest, manifest with newlines/whitespace, tab-indented
base = open('/workspace/examples/manifest.json','rb').read()
tests = {
 'crlf': base.replace(b'\n', b'\r\n'),
 'pretty': json.dumps(json.loads(base), indent=2).encode(),
 'tabs': json.dumps(json.loads(base), indent='\t').encode(),
 'leading_ws': b'\n\n  ' + base + b'\n\t',
}
for name, data in tests.items():
    p = '/workspace/tmp/dev/t/m_%s.json' % name
    open(p,'wb').write(data)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/submission/ipv6_replay.py','plan',p],capture_output=True)
    exp = json.load(open('/workspace/examples/expected-plan.json'))
    print(name, 'exit', r.returncode, 'match', (r.returncode==0 and json.loads(r.stdout)==exp))
EOF
